definition: Leaders of a tribe, clan, or other traditional community.
author: Homer
quote: In quest of these Ulysses took a long journey while still quite young, for his father and the other chieftains sent him on a mission to recover them.
example_sentence: The chieftains met on the hill to settle the feud.
